description: This file defines a PHP class 'BaseConfig' that extends ArrayObject, providing methods to merge configurations, check existence of values, retrieve values with defaults, evaluate truthiness, and set values within a configuration object.

classes.name: BaseConfig
classes.description: A class that manages configuration data as an array, providing utility methods to merge, access, and modify configuration entries.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges new key-value pairs into the configuration, optionally overriding existing values.

methods.name: hasValue
methods.description: Checks if a given key exists in the configuration.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key, or returns a default if not present.

methods.name: isTruthy
methods.description: Determines if the value associated with a key is truthy.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets or updates the value for a given key in the configuration.
